headlines.description: — Cam Spencer scored 26 points, Taylor Hendricks added 20, including a key pair of free throws with 2.3 seconds remaining, and the Memphis Grizzlies set a franchise record with their eighth straight road win, defeating the Cleveland Cavaliers 124-121...
headlines.shortLinkText: Grizzlies beat Cavaliers 124-121 for a franchise-record 8th straight road win

headlines.description: — Kevin Durant scored 21 points and Reed Sheppard made six 3-pointers and finished with 20 points as the Houston Rockets beat the Indiana Pacers 119-104 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kevin Durant scores 21 to help Rockets overpower Pacers 119-104 despite losing Sengun to injury

headlines.description: — Giannis Antetokounmpo scored 27 points and nearly got a triple-double in his first game against his former franchise, Bam Adebayo had 21 of his 26 points in the first half and the sizzling Miami Heat downed the sliding Milwaukee Bucks 137-130 on...
headlines.shortLinkText: Giannis gets win over Bucks in 1st meeting as Heat hang on late for 137-130 victory

headlines.description: — Joel Embiid scored 26 points, VJ Edgecombe added a season-high 24 and LeBron James finished with 22 as the Philadelphia 76ers beat Orlando 121-116 on Wednesday night, halting the Magic's four-game winning streak.
headlines.shortLinkText: Embiid, Edgecombe, James power the 76ers to a 121-116 win over Magic

headlines.description: — Matas Buzelis scored a season-high 25 points, Josh Giddey had 18 points, 14 rebounds and nine assists, and the Chicago Bulls rolled to their easiest victory of the season by beating the Brooklyn Nets 137-107 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bulls roll to a 137-107 victory over the Nets in their easiest win of the season

headlines.description: — Anthony Davis had 25 points and 14 rebounds, rookie AJ Dybantsa added 23 points and 12 boards, and the Washington Wizards beat the undermanned Toronto Raptors 103-99 on Wednesday night to snap an eight-game losing streak.
headlines.shortLinkText: Davis and Dybantsa lead the Wizards past the Raptors 103-99 in a matchup of struggling teams

events.name: Detroit Pistons at New Orleans Pelicans

headlines.description: — John Collins hit four 3-pointers and scored 20 points to lead seven Detroit players in double figures as the Pistons beat the New Orleans Pelicans 122-109 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: John Collins scores 20 points and Pistons hit 17 3s in 122-109 win over Pelicans

events.name: Atlanta Hawks at Oklahoma City Thunder

headlines.description: — Onyeka Okongwu scored 28 points, Nickeil Alexander-Walker added 19 and the Atlanta Hawks outlasted the Oklahoma City Thunder 117-112 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Hawks outlast the Thunder 117-112 as Dort and Wiggins make winning returns to Oklahoma City

events.name: Golden State Warriors at Dallas Mavericks

headlines.description: — Cooper Flagg scored 33 points, P.J. Washington Jr. added 21 and the Dallas Mavericks stopped a three-game losing streak with a 116-94 victory over the Golden State Warriors on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cooper Flagg scores 33 as Mavericks keep Warriors winless since Stephen Curry's injury

headlines.description: — Nikola Jokic had 24 points, nine assists and eight rebounds, Jamal Murray had 21 points, seven rebounds and four steals, and the Denver Nuggets overcame a 17-point first-half deficit to defeat the Boston Celtics 105-101 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jokic scores 24, Murray adds 21; Nuggets rally from 17-point deficit to beat Celtics 105-101

events.name: Utah Jazz at Los Angeles Lakers

headlines.description: — Keyonte George scored nine of his 30 points in the fourth quarter, and the Utah Jazz improbably snapped the Los Angeles Lakers' nine-game winning streak with a 109-97 victory Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jazz snap Lakers' 9-game winning streak with 109-97 victory behind Keyonte George's 30 points

headlines.description: — Dillon Brooks and Devin Booker scored 29 points apiece as the Phoenix Suns defeated Sacramento 128-107 Wednesday night, sending the Kings to their seventh straight loss.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brooks and Booker score 29 apiece as Suns send Kings to 7th straight loss 128-107
